questions.prompt: How are the two parts of the funding connected?
options: One supports existing woodland and the other supports new woodland.
One funds farm equipment and the other funds household gardens.
One supports trees outside woods and the other supports local recovery work.
One repairs parks and the other funds research into tree diseases.
questions.explanationZh: 第3—5句明确是林地外植树基金，第10—11句为地方自然恢复；不能换成现有与新林地、农具家庭花园或公园与树病研究的分工。

questions.prompt: What does the figure of 500,000 describe?
options: The upper target for trees supported outside woodlands.
The number of woodland owners who can apply.
Trees to be planted separately by each authority.
questions.explanationZh: up to为上限，且第6句明确尚非已完成的植树数量，也不是每个地方政府单独的目标。

questions.prompt: Why does the article compare a wetland with a hot street?
options: To explain how the two funds will be shared equally.
To describe projects already completed with the new money.
To compare the number of authorities in rural and urban areas.
To show how local risks can lead to different choices.
questions.explanationZh: 第13句分别列举湿地减轻洪水风险和树木为街道降温，第14句总结各地可以有不同优先事项；不是平分资金、完成项目或比较地方政府数量。

questions.prompt: Which information was not yet provided in full at the announcement?
options: Further details of the Community Trees Fund.
The total amount of the two funding parts.
The planned years of the Community Trees Fund.
Examples of people involved in local strategies.
questions.explanationZh: 第15句明确指出树木基金细节待公布；总额、时间和参与者的例子都已写出。
